articles.summary: RALEIGH, N.C., June 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cardinal Infrastructure Group, Inc., (Nasdaq: CDNL) ("Cardinal" or "the Company") announced the acquisition of Piedmont Pipe Construction, Inc., ("Piedmont"). Founded in 1999, Piedmont is a leading wet utilities provider across North and South Carolina.
articles.title: Cardinal Infrastructure Group Announces Acquisition of Piedmont Pipe Construction

(the "Company" or "Cardinal") (Nasdaq: CDNL) today announced that it has closed its upsized underwritten public offering of 4,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a price to the public of $73.00 per share.
